channel.title: USA AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of US political, economic and security developments

item.title: Latter-day Saints women turn away from scandal-plagued Republican candidate in Arizona
item.description: Arizona Republican candidate for Congress Mark Lamb has been accused of sexual misconduct while sheriff. His controversy is turning many voters away as Democrats see an opportunity in the red seat.

item.title: Opinion: A Hawk is not the same as a Hawkeye
item.description: This was emphasized to people watching a Senate hearing this week, where confusion over two basketball teams was on display.

item.title: The Supreme Court faces another term jam-packed with controversy
item.description: The Supreme Court term opens on Monday with big test cases on religion, guns and climate change. Plus, the emergency docket keeps popping.

item.title: Meet the voters who could break the GOP’s decadeslong grip on a Republican stronghold
item.description: Black and Hispanic voter turnout could decide whether James Talarico breaks a 30-year Democratic drought in the Texas Senate race this fall.

item.title: Latin America’s conservative shift faces its biggest test yet in Brazil election
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva barely leads Flavio Bolsonaro in Brazil election polls as analysts say the vote could reshape conservatism in the Americas.

item.title: Supreme Court kicks off new term with fresh questions over its legitimacy and its future
item.description: The Supreme Court opens its new term with major cases on gun rights, voter citizenship and religious liberty amid record-low public approval ratings.

item.title: Southern Baptist president calls on pastors to 'step up' ahead of midterm elections
item.description: Willy Rice says pastors must "step up" on abortion, marriage, gender identity and immigration, arguing these political issues are deeply theological.

item.title: California K-9 Otis helps police seize 440 pounds of cocaine during Alhambra traffic stop
item.description: K-9 Otis sniffed out roughly 440 pounds of cocaine during a California traffic stop after the driver's shifting stories raised red flags to responding officers.

item.title: Shooting near Baltimore youth football event leaves 12-year-old girl dead, 3 adults wounded
item.description: A parking dispute near a youth football event at Leon Day Park in Baltimore turned deadly when two men allegedly opened fire on each other, killing a 12-year-old girl in the crossfire.

item.title: Texas mother facing capital murder charges after allegedly shooting her two sons to death
item.description: Colleen Nichole Lemmon allegedly told officers she shot both her sons at their Waxahachie home before deputies found her with self-inflicted injuries.

item.title: Trump touts ‘golden age’ at Ohio rally, urges voters to deliver GOP midterm wins
item.description: President Donald Trump urged Ohio rally-goers to "pretend I'm on the ballot" as he stumped for Jon Husted and Vivek Ramaswamy in the midterms.

item.title: France’s violent student protests raise warning for America: ‘A cautionary tale’
item.description: "The Big Weekend Show" co-host says the country's violent student protests are "a cautionary tale" for the U.S., warning open borders lead to unrest and misplaced anger.

item.title: Should Big Oil pay for climate change? A Supreme Court case will help decide.
item.description: Boulder, Colo., is hoping its novel lawsuit will be the environmental equivalent of the landmark litigation that produced billions in damages and settlements against Big Tobacco and opioid makers.

item.title: ‘Dying on the vine’: How a farmer ended up with 1,600 tons of unwanted grapes
item.description: Falling demand for juice has left Lake Erie grape growers with fruit they can’t sell.

item.title: Body-cam footage shows moment Luigi Mangione was arrested at a McDonald’s
item.description: Newly released video records his arrest in Pennsylvania in connection with the shooting of health care executive Brian Thompson.

item.title: Governor slams district attorney, Cornell police on handling of rape allegations
item.description: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul (D) also called on legislators to tighten a law limiting the ability to prosecute sexual assault if a victim voluntarily became intoxicated.

item.title: Another disappointing jobs report suggests more challenges for Trump, GOP
item.description: The unemployment rate ticked up to 4.2 percent while wages continued to lag behind inflation in the government’s final jobs report before the Nov. 3 midterm election.

item.title: With threats to midterms, states say Trump administration isn’t helping
item.description: U.S. spy agencies see Russia and others plotting to sow distrust and misinformation in the upcoming elections.

item.title: How Democrats hope to reverse Trump’s changes to the presidency
item.description: As the midterms approach, some of the president’s foes are working to ensure his aggressive approach to executive power doesn’t outlast him.
